## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The PR adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register new files, with tests for both. The refresh helper can erase evidence of edits to tracked files and should be fixed before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — If `tracked.txt` changes after its fingerprint is recorded, calling `refresh_fingerprints` with `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` overwrites the original fingerprint; the refresh test only exercises an unchanged tracked file. — Subsequent verification accepts the hand-edited file, defeating the stated integrity guarantee.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Registration tests check preservation of existing fingerprints after edits, duplicate names, and empty input.
